text:
alice: Quick flag: hitting a reproducible dup-create with async python client + timeouts + retries. Seen on 0.9.3.

alice: Minimal repro (trimmed):
```python
from uuid import uuid4
from redwood import RedwoodAsyncClient

client = RedwoodAsyncClient(api_key='...', timeout=2)

async def create():
    idemp = str(uuid4())
    await client.post('/v1/objects', json={'name': 't'}, headers={'Idempotency-Key': idemp}, retry_policy={'max_retries': 3, 'backoff_factor': 0.3})
```

alice: What I saw: server returned 201 on first try, client got a read timeout, SDK retried and server created a second object -> duplicate. I expected either no retry for non-idempotent POSTs by default or that the Idempotency-Key be preserved across replay.

ben: Which release line? we changed async retry plumbing recently. Can you paste the raw traces?

alice: logs snippet: 
OUT: POST /v1/objects 201 id:req_A headers:{Idempotency-Key: key123}
OUT: read timeout waiting for response
OUT: retry #1 -> POST /v1/objects -> 201 id:req_B headers:{}

carla: Two leads: 1) async client historically didn't auto-add Idempotency-Key for POSTs (sync did), 2) typing issue: async constructor annotated retry_policy as RetryPolicy | None but call-sites often pass dicts; downstream code does isinstance(retry_policy, RetryPolicy) and skips backoff logic if it's a plain dict. Also replay logic might not copy headers into the retried request.

carla: Short-term workaround: construct RetryPolicy explicitly or include idempotency headers yourself. e.g.
```python
from redwood.retry import RetryPolicy
policy = RetryPolicy(max_retries=3, backoff_factor=0.5)
await client.post(..., retry_policy=policy)
```

alice: Confirmed the workaround prevents dupes in my flaky local test. I'll open an issue + PR to coerce dict -> RetryPolicy in async client and to ensure headers survive replays.

ben: Please add a unit test that simulates a half-closed socket / read-timeout plus server 5xx so we cover the replay path and assert same Idempotency-Key is sent. Add a changelog note; this is risky for customers.

carla: For typing, change signature to retry_policy: RetryPolicy | dict | None and add a runtime coercion helper that validates keys rather than widening to Any.

alice: Filing issue and working on PR now, assigning to @ben for review.

ci-bot: unit tests started (job id 4972)

ben: If CI passes we should cut a patch release. Also add a short quickstart note about async idempotency behavior until release ships.

alice: Will update quickstart and include sync/async parity tests. Thanks all :thumbsup:
